messages:
Mia Chen: Hey team — LumenaFin POC kickoff. Need alignment on success criteria, golden prompt set, and security Qs before EOW. They want a 2-week pilot starting May 4. Main asks: invoice classification + entity extraction accuracy, latency target, and a cost ceiling. I attached the draft SOW and their security questionnaire (see drive). @Devon can you propose an eval rubric?

Devon Park: TL;DR propose a composite scoring approach: 60% extraction accuracy (F1), 25% classification accuracy, 10% latency SLA, 5% cost delta. Regression gates: any drop >3% F1 vs baseline fails. Latency gate: 95th p95 must be <=400ms on test harness.

Rafael Ortiz: Uploading initial golden prompts/examples — starting small (50 seed rows) covering edge cases. Sample entries below (will put CSV in drive):

```
# prompt: invoice text
# expected: {
#   "invoice_id": "INV-2024-183",
#   "vendor": "Acme Supplies",
#   "total": "$4,128.50",
#   "line_items": [ {"desc":"widget","qty":10,"unit":"$412.85"} ]
# }
```

Example 2: OCR noise, numbers split across lines — expected entity normalization. Example 3: multi-vendor aggregated invoice — expected 2 invoice objects.

Rafael Ortiz: For scoring, we'll use normalized string matching + numeric tolerance (amounts +/- 0.5%). We'll tag partial matches as 0.5.

Sanjay Patel: Security Qs status: I reviewed their questionnaire. Outstanding items: 1) confirmation of KMS provider (they asked for HSM-backed KMS), 2) data residency — Lumena requires EU-only storage for some customers, 3) full SOC2 evidence pack requested. Quick answers: we can support HSM via our KMS partner (need to confirm key policy), we have region pinning for EU, SOC2 report available but need to share under NDA. I'll own responses and follow up with PCI/PII scoping.

Nora Li: Pricing note: For a 2-week POC I recommend a trial credit bundle: 200k tokens + dedicated reserved instance for 10 days at discounted rate (we absorb GPU spin-up). If they like metrics we can recommend a committed Dedicated for production. @Mia do we want to offer a one-time POC discount or tie to a timeline? Also need legal to sign the DPA/NDA before we share SOC2.

Mia Chen: Good notes. Owners: Rafael = golden set + CSV by Tue, Devon = harness scoring implementation + test harness by Wed, Sanjay = sec questionnaire answers + NDA handoff, Nora = POC commercial note & draft credit terms. Timeline: firm start May 4, preflight checks complete by May 1. If anyone sees blockers speak now.

Devon Park: I'll add the eval harness config: 3 runs (baseline open-model, quantized model, fallback model). We'll collect per-case labels: pass/exact/partial/fail and compute composite. Regression gate: composite score must not drop >2.5% from baseline on the seed.

Rafael Ortiz: Sample golden CSV header I'll use: id,text,expected_json,category,edge_case_tag. I'll seed 50 rows with ~30% edge cases (split amounts, OCR artifacts, missing vendor lines). Uploading link shortly.

Sanjay Patel: Quick FAQ answers to prepare for Lumena security team: "We encrypt data at rest with AES-256, keys in KMS (HSM option available), in-transit TLS1.2+, optional VPC peering, audit logs retained 90 days by default (extendable)." I'll add exact SOC2 statement once legal clears sharing.

Nora Li: I'll draft the POC commercial email: 2-week pilot, 200k tokens, one reserved GPU node for test, POC discount of 30% on list. If they convert within 30 days we apply credit back. Sending the draft to legal ops rn.

Mia Chen: Action items recap in channel and I'll create a Miro board for prompt taxonomy. Please confirm when you upload artifacts so I can notify Lumena PM.

Rafael Ortiz: Confirmed — CSV + examples uploaded to drive (link in thread). I'll tag difficult cases with comments.

Devon Park: I'll push the harness config to the repo and share a run cmd: `./run_eval --config lumena.yaml --golden golden.csv` in the thread. Will monitor p95 during runs.

Sanjay Patel: Sec-bot: Security questionnaire updated — shared with Lumena under NDA. (sec-bot)

Mia Chen: Thanks. If we can hit these gates for the seed set, push to success criteria doc and I'll sync with the customer on Friday. :thumbsup:

Nora Li: +1 — I'll request signature on the DPA and nudge their legal.
